# Daily Briefing – Wednesday 11 November

Yesterday was a solid rest day, Ben. No structured session, 7,675 steps keeping you gently active, and you burned 2,471 kcal — nicely above your 2,300 target, so your deficit is working. Sleep at 6 hours is the one flag worth noting.

Your HRV sits at 92ms, just inside the lower edge of your 91–122ms baseline, and your resting HR of 52 bpm looks excellent. Stress at 43 is moderate. The slightly low HRV combined with short sleep suggests your body is recovered enough to train, but don't chase intensity today — steady aerobic work is your sweet spot.

That 6-hour sleep is quietly undermining your recovery and fat loss. Prioritise 7.5–8 hours tonight — it'll sharpen your HRV and help preserve muscle while you're in that calorie deficit. Early bed tonight, no negotiating!
